input.request: Build Repair Deposit, an appliance-repair deposit page. Token name: Repair Deposit. Token symbol: RPR. The fixed total supply is 1,000,000,000 tokens with 18 decimals (1,000,000,000 * 10^18 base units), minted once to the deployer. RepairDeposit lets a customer open a job for a repairer with a bytes32 device hash, deposited RPR amount and deadline; the repairer marks work complete, the customer releases payment, or the customer reclaims an uncompleted job after deadline. Deploy on Sepolia and publish a page to open jobs, mark completion, release or reclaim.
input.context: Sepolia only (chainId 11155111); GitHub and IPFS are approved. Include Foundry tests and an independent adversarial review. Constructors use only address, uint256, bool or bytes32 arguments; the launch token constructor is zero-argument. foundry.toml must set bytecode_hash = "none". No proxy, delegatecall or selfdestruct. Customer and repairer call the actions that determine their own payment or refund; no automatic settlement is promised.

draft.objective: Build and review RPR and RepairDeposit, deploy them on Sepolia, then publish the live repair-deposit website.

steps.objective: Implement fixed-supply RPR and customer-funded repair job escrow.
Test participants, completion, release, deadline refunds, and exact accounting.
Independently adversarially review repair deposit transitions.
Build the live repair-job page with all wallet actions.
